name: Toledo
takeaway: Toledo is on NOAC at 9.75¢ — repriced from a lower baseline. City is the anchor of a 13-community coalition with a captive rate. Competitive supply can improve on this.
hook: Toledo is locked into the NOAC program at 9.75¢ — have you compared that against what's available in the open market right now?
notes: NOAC (Northwest Ohio Aggregation Coalition) serves 13 communities via Toledo Edison/FirstEnergy. Current supplier: Dynegy at 9.75¢/kWh. Gas: variable NYMEX+$0.2092/Ccf through Apr 2028. NOAC switched from Energy Harbor to Dynegy June 2025. Dynegy contract (8.63¢→9.75¢) ended May 2026. New NOAC contract terms being finalized.
